issue.title: Add a static Bitcoin 1Y price chart card
issue.description:
Add a new full-width Bitcoin 1Y price showcase card to the Cards gallery, positioned directly after Studio revenue in the larger/right region.

Intent:

* Create a minimal, clean, elegant financial/market card focused on Bitcoin's one-year price movement.
* Keep the implementation deliberately simple and static.
* Use hard-coded historical Bitcoin price points only; no live data infrastructure.

Placement:

* Insert the Bitcoin card directly after Studio revenue.
* Keep it as another full-width rectangular card in the larger/right gallery region.
* Preserve the accepted container-responsive gallery architecture and independent vertical flow.

Visual structure:

* Small Bitcoin / BTC identifier near the top-left.
* Subtle 1Y range indicator near the top-right.
* Large price value.
* Small 1-year percentage change indicator.
* One full-width line chart beneath.

Chart implementation:

* Use shadcn's official Line Chart - Dots pattern as the implementation basis:
  [https://ui.shadcn.com/charts/line#charts](<https://ui.shadcn.com/charts/line#charts>)
* Reuse the accepted Chart/Recharts architecture already in Personal UI.
* Keep visible dots on the line, but style them in a restrained way.
* Use semantic/chart tokens rather than hard-coding Bitcoin orange.

Chart simplification:

* No background grid lines.
* No x-axis labels at the bottom.
* No y-axis labels.
* No legend.
* No secondary series.
* No extra controls/toolbars.
* Avoid tooltip complexity unless the existing chart architecture provides a very lightweight tooltip essentially for free.
* The visual should read primarily as the line + dots.

Data:

* Use a small hard-coded one-year historical Bitcoin USD dataset.
* Prefer approximately monthly points across 12 months.
* Use real historical BTC/USD prices from a reliable source during implementation, then commit those values as static data.
* No API calls.
* No runtime fetch.
* No live refresh.
* No crypto SDK.
* No external credentials.
* No data synchronization or state machinery beyond what the card actually needs.

Data provenance:

* Record the source/date used to obtain the static historical prices in a code comment, composition note, or test fixture provenance where appropriate.
* Once committed, the card remains deterministic and does not depend on the source at runtime.

Content scope:

* No buy/sell buttons.
* No wallet controls.
* No crypto news.
* No portfolio logic.
* No timeframe switching beyond the fixed visible 1Y indicator.
* No trading workflow.

Design-system constraints:

* Keep all styling driven by Personal UI semantic/chart tokens.
* Use Body/Sans typography unless existing financial-number conventions in the accepted composition clearly justify another existing role.
* Preserve light/dark behavior.
* Do not introduce new tokens or public resources.
* Do not change Theme v3, history, persistence, Design Command, or mutation behavior.

Acceptance:

* A new Bitcoin 1Y card appears directly after Studio revenue in the larger/right region.
* Card is full-width within that region.
* Card shows Bitcoin/BTC identifier, 1Y label, price value, and one-year percentage change.
* Chart uses the shadcn Line Chart - Dots pattern.
* Chart shows only the price line and dots without background grid lines, x-axis labels, y-axis labels, or legend.
* Data is hard-coded static historical BTC/USD data spanning about one year.
* No runtime network/API/crypto dependency exists.
* Static data provenance is documented.
* Card remains responsive, token-driven, light/dark coherent, and geometry-stable.
* No overflow, accessibility, focus-order, or gallery-layout regression.
